name: app-user-persona-slide-with-nested-hairline-circles
title: User persona slide with a portrait rising from concentric hairline circles
whatItIs: A near-white slide with a headline mixing light sans and bold italic serif. A cut-out portrait emerges from a frosted name badge on top of two nested thin circles; the inner circle holds a quote, the outer holds goals. Pain and Gain notes sit at the left and right, and a small icon dock sits below.
whatItMeans: Human and elegant; circles centre the person while research findings orbit around them.
techniques: Nest hairline circles around a portrait to organise persona facts.
Let the head break above the circle for depth.
Place opposing notes (Pain, Gain) at both sides.
Use tiny avatar thumbnails to switch personas.

vocabulary.definition: A fictional profile representing a user group.
A pair of notes contrasting frustrations and benefits.
A small pill of icons used to switch views.
